steps.name: Bind original qualified native source and locked reader dependencies
steps.run:
git fetch --no-tags --depth=1 origin 17e8e622ecd3307a246196cbb5ca06c0fac37301
python3 -m pip install --requirement tools/requirements.lock

steps.name: Install the original normal captured compiler boundary
steps.run:
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install --yes bubblewrap libgdbm6t64 libreadline8t64 libsqlite3-0 liblttng-ust1t64 libtcl8.6 libtk8.6
sudo sysctl -w kernel.apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns=0
python3 -B tools/install_guest_bindgen.py "$RUNNER_TEMP/compatibility-bindgen"
echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/compatibility-bindgen" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

steps.name: Authenticate the ordinary official SDK29 compiler for managed cells
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
curl --fail --location --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 --max-time 180 https://github.com/WebAssembly/wasi-sdk/releases/download/wasi-sdk-29/wasi-sdk-29.0-x86_64-linux.tar.gz --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/compatibility-wasi-sdk.tar.gz"
echo "87d1d1a2879d139cdc624b968efad3d4a97b8078cdff95e63ac88ecafd1a0171  $RUNNER_TEMP/compatibility-wasi-sdk.tar.gz" | sha256sum --check --strict
tar -xzf "$RUNNER_TEMP/compatibility-wasi-sdk.tar.gz" -C "$RUNNER_TEMP"

steps.name: Authenticate original Gradle and prepare only its normal compiler cache
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
curl --fail --location --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 --max-time 180 https://services.gradle.org/distributions/gradle-9.1.0-bin.zip --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/compatibility-gradle.zip"
echo "a17ddd85a26b6a7f5ddb71ff8b05fc5104c0202c6e64782429790c933686c806  $RUNNER_TEMP/compatibility-gradle.zip" | sha256sum --check --strict
unzip -q "$RUNNER_TEMP/compatibility-gradle.zip" -d "$RUNNER_TEMP"
export PATH="$RUNNER_TEMP/gradle-9.1.0/bin:$PATH"
echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/gradle-9.1.0/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
python3 -B tools/qualify_compatibility_closure.py --prepare-java-cache --tools "$RUNNER_TEMP/wasi-sdk-29.0-x86_64-linux" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/compatibility-java-prerequisite"

steps.name: Install original normal TypeScript tools without an engine build
Authenticate original Go1.27.3 and componentize-go0.4.3 and prepare the maintained v5 compiler
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
out="$RUNNER_TEMP/go-http-tenant-tools"
test ! -e "$out"
mkdir "$out"
curl --fail --location --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 --max-time 180 --output "$out/go.tar.gz" https://dl.google.com/go/go1.27.3.linux-amd64.tar.gz
echo "65efbc80fdc1fa2cd2631cad5b481777a68e8725f34e89f50fc6ac714e379b40  $out/go.tar.gz" | sha256sum --check --strict
tar -xzf "$out/go.tar.gz" -C "$out"
curl --fail --location --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 --max-time 180 --output "$out/componentize-go.tar.gz" https://github.com/bytecodealliance/componentize-go/releases/download/v0.4.3/componentize-go-linux-amd64.tar.gz
echo "1061d845f550df5d9477612a7d458a31b1e2b8bdc95823704e42e5064deb0c52  $out/componentize-go.tar.gz" | sha256sum --check --strict
tar -xzf "$out/componentize-go.tar.gz" -C "$out" componentize-go
echo "b41803a645e54845bc8eacef9a69e0eeb8c2c4a9a61964c831ed544e85c137cb  $out/componentize-go" | sha256sum --check --strict
chmod 755 "$out/componentize-go"
test "$("$out/componentize-go" --version)" = 'componentize-go 0.4.3'
test "$(wasm-tools --version | cut -d ' ' -f 1,2)" = 'wasm-tools 1.254.0'
python3 -B tools/go_guest/runtime.py --prepare-compiler "$out/go" --output "$out/go-async"
echo "$out" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
echo "$out/go-async/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
